study type: Prospective observational study with acute intervention
exposure: Neonate head posture (right lateral decubitus, left lateral decubitus)
outcome: Lateral ventricular volume (measured by three-dimensional ultrasound)
cohort: The study included 24 preterm neonates (18 unstable and 6 relatively stable) recruited from Victoria Hospital, London, Ontario.
finding: Head positioned to any lateral side for 30 minutes does not result in a statistically significant difference in the lateral ventricular volumes of neonates.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken acutely during hospitalization, with stable infants positioned for 30 minutes before imaging.
